definitions.explanation: The act or sensation of something shaking or swaying back and forth. Most commonly associated with earthquakes in Japanese daily life. From the verb 揺れる (to shake). Can also describe the swaying of a boat, building, or even emotional wavering.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{揺|ゆ}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{揺|ゆ}れ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三十秒|さんじゅうびょう}ほど⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The earthquake shaking lasted about thirty seconds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{揺|ゆ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しくて→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧、⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The rocking of the boat was so intense that I started feeling sick.

notes:
USAGE:
In earthquake-prone Japan, {揺|ゆ}れ is a word heard frequently in news reports and emergency broadcasts. The intensity of shaking is described with adjectives like ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ (big), ⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧ (small), ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧ (violent), or ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ (long-lasting).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縦|たて}{揺|ゆ}れ (vertical shaking — in an earthquake)
- {横|よこ}{揺|ゆ}れ (horizontal shaking)
- {揺|ゆ}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel shaking)
- ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{揺|ゆ}れ (strong shaking)
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{揺|ゆ}れ (emotional wavering — figurative)
